notes:
{今回|こんかい} means "this time" or "this occasion," often implying comparison with other times.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今回|こんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜: this time...
- {今回|こんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: this (current) ...
- {今回|こんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何回目|なんかいめ}→何回目：30343_nankaime⟧: which time is this?
- {今回|こんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: this time only

SIMILAR WORDS:

USAGE:
{今回|こんかい} is commonly used in news and formal contexts to refer to "the current case/incident."
